lines.zh: 我用翼尖撑着地，往前挪。
lines.en: I push along the ground on my wing tips.

lines.zh: 落地之后，我走得像只笨鸟。
lines.en: On the ground I waddle like an awkward bird.
This frame of mine is very light.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸线蹦了两步。
lines.en: I hop twice along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 风一大，我就想张开翅膀。
lines.en: When the wind picks up, my wings want to open.
I keep my beak low to clear the brush.

lines.zh: 脚爪抓着沙子，一步一陷。
lines.en: My claws grip the sand and sink with each step.
I walk in the shadow of my flock.

lines.zh: 走不了多远，还是飞省事。
lines.en: Walking does not last; flying is easier.
I drag my wing membrane around the rocks.
I know this stretch, and the surf sounds right.
The beach is full of my claw marks.

lines.zh: 我拍了两下翅膀，稳住身子。
lines.en: Two beats of my wings steady me.
Short legs, but I am in no rush.

lines.zh: 我站在礁石上，望着海面。
lines.en: I stand on the rocks and watch the sea.
The wind slips past my beak. Pleasant.

lines.zh: 水里一闪，我记下了位置。
lines.en: A flicker in the water; I mark the spot.
I fold my wings and bask.
Daylight suits my eyes.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听浪底下的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head at sounds beneath the waves.

lines.zh: 翅膜凉下来，我就抖一抖。
lines.en: When my membrane cools, I shake it out.
I wait for the fish to come into the shallows.
My belly is empty; my patience is not.

lines.zh: 上头那块骨脊，是我的招牌。
lines.en: That crest on my jaw is my mark.
There is a flock far off. I will not join.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸脖子，活动关节。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and work the joints.
I have circled this bay three times.
I need a full belly before the sun drops.
You are taller than me. That is unusual.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，一只眼锁住你的手。
lines.en: I tilt my head and lock one eye on your hand.
Might you be holding a fish?

lines.zh: 我在算你离水边的距离。
lines.en: I am reckoning how far you are from the water.
Have you come to steal my fish?
I am not afraid of you. I can fly.
My crest is turned your way.

lines.zh: 就停在那儿，别再往前迈。
lines.en: Stop right there and take no further step.

lines.zh: 你脚下那滩水，有鱼腥味。
lines.en: The puddle by your feet smells of fish.
I blink, and you are still there.
Come nearer and I take off.

lines.zh: 一整个白天，我都看得见你。
lines.en: All day long, I can see you.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一歪，差点栽下去。
lines.en: My wing skewed and I nearly dropped.

lines.zh: 这一下打疼了我的骨头。
lines.en: That struck my hollow bones hard.

lines.zh: 一声尖叫卡在我喉咙里。
lines.en: A screech catches in my throat.
I stagger back half a step.
I can still fly with this.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，羽毛乱了。
lines.en: I shake my wings; my feathers are a mess.
It hurts, but I do not yield.

lines.zh: 我贴地滑开，躲了第二下。
lines.en: I skim low and dodge the second blow.
There is a tear in my membrane.
I pant, my beak hanging open.
I can see that fish.
I am not fussy, so long as it is fresh.
I glide down and land at your feet.

lines.zh: 你把那条鱼拿稳，我要下来了。
lines.en: Hold that fish steady; I am coming down.
Give me fish and I will follow a while.
I have it. Do not grab.
That one went down nicely.
I stretch my neck for another.
Where there is fish, there am I.
When I am full, I return to the rocks.
You knocked my wing askew.
I flap and give two steps of ground.
This skeleton of mine rattles at a touch.
Do not step on my membrane.
I squeeze past your leg.
You are far heavier. I yield.
We collided and I nearly tipped over.

lines.zh: 我的喙磕在你护甲上，疼。
lines.en: My beak cracked against your armor. Ow.

lines.zh: 翅膀展不开，你先挪开些。
lines.en: My wings cannot open; shift aside a little.

lines.zh: 擦了一下，掉了几根绒毛。
lines.en: A graze, and a few downy feathers fell.
I land beside it with a fish in my beak.
A touch of wings and it is settled.
It flies first; I follow.

lines.zh: 空中绕两圈，是我们的话。
lines.en: Two circles in the air are our words.
That flat ledge is just right.
We build in a crevice of the rock.
One egg needs a long watch.

lines.zh: 它一唤，我就衔着鱼回应。
lines.en: When it calls, I answer with a fish in my beak.

lines.zh: 这段时间，我不抢别人的鱼。
lines.en: For now I will not steal anyone's fish.

lines.zh: 我们一起侧过翅膀滑翔。
lines.en: We bank and glide wing to wing.
Something is floating on the sea.
I dip down and take it in my beak.
A fish that small still fills a gap.
I pick it up and shake off the water.
You dropped something. Do I want it?
It is heavy; carrying it is work.
I set it on a rock to look it over.
Not a fish. I am not interested.
I toss it up and swallow.
I will keep this one for later.
I saw that one in the water.
I fold my wings and take aim.
That shape is not far from shore.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到它背上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches its back before I do.
Not stealing today; today I hunt.
It does not know I am above.
I drop low and skim the wave tops.
One dive will cover this distance.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一边，跑不掉的。
lines.en: A mate is on the other side. It will not escape.
What I fix on, I do not lose.

lines.zh: 我把骨脊压下去，减小风阻。
lines.en: I lower my crest to cut the wind.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一摆，我跟着偏。
lines.en: Its tail flicks and I correct.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，落单这条归我。
lines.en: The school has scattered; the loner is mine.
My beak tip is lined up.
I circle once and drop a little lower.

lines.zh: 它往深处游，我等它上来。
lines.en: It dives deep, so I wait for it to rise.
The daylight helps me track it.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我就知道它转向。
lines.en: The water shifts and I know it turned.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，几乎不出声。
lines.en: I skim the surface almost silently.

lines.zh: 它的水纹乱了，我知道成了。
lines.en: Its wake is ragged — I know I have it.
A little closer and I strike.
My flock drives it toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀撑住风，稳稳的。
lines.en: My wings hold the wind steadily.
It looks up and sees me.

lines.zh: 看见也没用，它游不过我。
lines.en: Seeing me is no help; it cannot outswim me.
I follow its shadow.
A wave turns and shows its back.
This time I want it alive.

lines.zh: 距离在缩，我的耐心在涨。
lines.en: The distance shrinks and my patience grows.
I dive and drive my beak down.
Claws hook first, then tear.
I bite its back and haul upward.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我从上面来的。
lines.en: That one came from above.

lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀，把它拖出水面。
lines.en: I beat my wings and drag it from the water.
One flick of my beak and blood shows.

lines.zh: 我脖子一拧，撕下一整条肉。
lines.en: One twist of the neck tears off a whole strip.

lines.zh: 它挣得再凶，我的喙也不松。
lines.en: However it thrashes, my beak will not loosen.
I ride the swell and strike again and again.

lines.zh: 这点反抗，挡不住我的喙。
lines.en: That resistance will not stop my beak.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，用翼骨撞过去。
lines.en: I roll and strike with my wing bone.
Its blood darkens the water.
I rise, then slam down again.
This catch will feed me all day.
I come through the sea mist.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，风就接住了我。
lines.en: My wings open and the wind takes me.
Which coast is this? The surf is wrong.
First I circle once to read the land.
There is wind up high. That is where I belong.

lines.zh: 这地方鱼不少，我闻到了。
lines.en: Plenty of fish here. I can smell them.

lines.zh: 落下来时，沙子扬了一片。
lines.en: When I land, sand flies up.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，没有同类应。
lines.en: I call once, and no kin answer.
The sun is high and so am I.

lines.zh: 我一掠，影子划过整片浅滩。
lines.en: I sweep past, and my shadow crosses the shallows.
Find a rock and watch from above.

lines.zh: 这世界的海，比我想的宽。
lines.en: This world's sea is wider than I expected.
I fold my wings and shake off the spray.
Wind slides past both sides of my crest.
I see movement along the shore.
This sky is mine to fly today.

lines.zh: 我落在一块平岩上，站稳。
lines.en: I settle on a flat rock and steady myself.
My belly is empty; I must find fish soon.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翼膜，一下就焦了。
lines.en: Flame licked my membrane and scorched it.

lines.zh: 从高空栽下来，骨头都震麻了。
lines.en: A fall from height leaves my bones numb.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的喙，我拼命拍翅。
lines.en: Water covers my beak and I beat my wings wildly.
The blast flipped me half over.

lines.zh: 一枚东西穿进了我的翼。
lines.en: Something punched through my wing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀忽然不听使唤。
lines.en: My wings suddenly will not obey.
Hunger makes my flight wobble.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我半边身子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and half my body went numb.
The wind is gone and I keep falling.
